features.name: Ability Score Increase
features.description: Your Strength score increases by 2, and your Charisma score increases by 1.

features.name: Size
features.description: Dragonborn are Medium creatures, standing well over 6 feet tall and weighing an average of 250 pounds.

features.name: Speed
features.description: Your base walking speed is 30 feet.

features.name: Draconic Ancestry
features.description: You have draconic ancestry. Choose one type of dragon; your breath weapon and damage resistance are determined by the dragon type.

choices.name: Draconic Ancestry
choices.description: Choose your draconic ancestor: Black (Acid), Blue (Lightning), Brass (Fire), Bronze (Lightning), Copper (Acid), Gold (Fire), Green (Poison), Red (Fire), Silver (Cold), White (Cold).

features.name: Breath Weapon
features.description: You can use your action to exhale destructive energy. Your draconic ancestry determines the size, shape, and damage type of the exhalation. A creature caught in the area must make a saving throw (Dex or Con, depending on ancestry), taking 2d6 damage on a failed save, or half as much on a success. The damage increases at higher levels. You can use this once per short or long rest.

payload.name: Breath Weapon
payload.description: Exhale energy determined by your Draconic Ancestry; save DC = 8 + CON mod + prof bonus. 2d6 damage at 1st, 3d6 at 6th, 4d6 at 11th, 5d6 at 16th.

features.name: Languages
features.description: You can speak, read, and write Common and Draconic.
